description:
Get one order: its locked quote, status, on-chain payment (txHash, payer, confirmations) and the signed receipt once confirmed. With store_id it reads the store's admin view (store key scope orders:read); without it, GET /api/v2/iap/orders/{id} (the buyer's own order, or any order of the store key's store) — what an app polls until status is 'confirmed'.

Params: order_id (0x + 64 hex), store_id?, session_token?
Returns: Order
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_404

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_get_order
title: Get a store order
